plan.title: Recreate Order Rejects Negative Evaluation Duration

steps.note: Open the existing awarded event's summary page as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order, leaving its window open.
Enter the invalid negative evaluation duration from the test case.
Try to create the order and require positive evidence that Procol rejects the negative duration.
